tips.Number of VOs: How many Village Organisations belong to this CLF.
tips.Number of SHGs: How many Self-Help Groups belong to this CLF, across all its VOs.
tips.Total Members: How many individual SHG members belong to this CLF.
tips.Active Members: How many of this CLF's members are currently marked active on LokOS, out of the total.
tips.Formation Date: The date this CLF was formed.
tips.Registration Date: The date this CLF was formally registered as a cooperative society.
tips.CLF Status: Whether this CLF is both Model and Registered, Model only, Registered only, or neither, based on the audit form.
tips.Platform Approval Status: Whether this CLF's registration on LokOS has been approved, is pending, or was rejected by the Block Manager.
tips.Co-option Status: Whether this CLF is newly formed, was co-opted from an earlier structure, or was revived after being inactive.
tips.Registration Code: This CLF's official state cooperative society registration number.
tips.Executive Committee Size: How many members sit on this CLF's Executive Committee.
tips.President: The name of this CLF's current President.
tips.Secretary: The name of this CLF's current Secretary.
tips.Subcommittee Membership: How many members sit on each of the CLF's six functional subcommittees.
tips.Meeting Frequency: How often this CLF's Executive Committee is supposed to meet.
tips.Savings Schedule: How often this CLF collects savings from its member VOs.
tips.Member Composition: The share of this CLF's members who belong to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes.
tips.Education & Literacy: The share of this CLF's members who can read and write.
tips.Members With a Livelihood: The share of this CLF's members who reported at least one livelihood activity (farm or non-farm) on their LokOS profile.
tips.Members With Multiple Livelihoods: The share of members who reported more than one livelihood activity.
tips.Livelihood Split: What kinds of livelihood activities this CLF's members are engaged in, combining their primary, secondary, and tertiary activities.
tips.Special Project Activities: Which optional CLF-run initiatives — like a Custom Hiring Centre, Didi Ki Rasoi, or livestock activities — this CLF has taken up, as reported in its audit.
tips.Cadre Roles in This CLF: Which specialised community-cadre roles (like Master Book Keeper, Enterprise Promotion, or Krishi Mitra) are staffed in this CLF, and how many members hold each.
tips.Audit Grade: This CLF's official letter grade from its most recent (Q4) audit.
tips.Total Audit Score: This CLF's total audit score out of 100, from its most recent (Q4) audit.
tips.Standing vs. Peers: How this CLF's total audit score compares to every other CLF in its district.
tips.Accounting: How well this CLF keeps its accounting books, cash/bank records, loan verification, MIS quality, and fixed-asset records — out of 19, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Receipts & Payments: How well this CLF manages and records its receipts and payments — out of 20, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Loan: How well this CLF reviews loan demand and manages loan repayment — out of 18, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Group Performance: How well this CLF's SHGs, VOs, and the CLF itself are functioning — out of 23, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Cadre Management: How well this CLF manages its cadre members — out of 10, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Operational Self-Sufficiency: How much of this CLF's running costs are covered by its own earned income — out of 10, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Detailed Scores: The individual line items that make up each audit category score, so you can see exactly where points were gained or lost.
tips.Irregularity Flag: Whether this CLF's Q4 audit flagged a financial irregularity.
tips.Type of Irregularity: Which category of issue the auditor's remark falls under - a flagged CLF can match more than one.
tips.Cash Book vs. Physical Cash: The difference between what the CLF's cash book says it should have on hand, and what was physically counted during the audit.
tips.Books Balance Check: Whether this CLF's reported Total Assets match its reported Total Liabilities & Equity.
tips.Liquidity Ratio: The share of this CLF's assets sitting as cash or bank balance, rather than out on loan or invested.
tips.Fund Deployment Ratio: The share of this CLF's financial assets that are actually out on loan to SHGs, VOs, or other CLFs, rather than sitting idle.
tips.Assets Composition: How this CLF's total assets break down across every balance-sheet line item - cash, bank balance, loans out to SHGs/VOs, fixed assets, and the rest.
tips.Liabilities Composition: How this CLF's total liabilities and equity break down across every balance-sheet line item - government grants, member capital, institutional loans, savings held on behalf of VOs/SHGs, and the rest.
tips.Surplus / Deficit: This CLF's reported surplus or deficit, shown as a share of its total assets — a negative number means a deficit.
tips.Net Cash Flow: The difference between what this CLF received and what it paid out this quarter.
tips.Where Money Came In From: What this quarter's receipts were made up of — savings deposits, interest earned, loan repayments, and other income.
tips.Where Money Went Out To: What this quarter's payments were made up of — loans and advances to member CBOs, running costs, and other expenses.
tips.Operating Expense Ratio: How much this CLF spent on its own running costs, as a share of everything it received this quarter.
tips.Interest Income Share: How much of this CLF's receipts came from interest earned by lending to members, rather than from deposits or other income.
tips.% of Loans Disbursed: Of everything ever requested by this CLF's member SHGs/VOs, how much has actually been disbursed to date.
tips.Loan Amount Still Pending: How much loan money has been requested by member SHGs/VOs but not yet disbursed.
tips.This Quarter's Disbursement Rate: Of the new loan demand raised this specific quarter, how much was actually disbursed.
tips.Capacity to Meet Demand: Whether this CLF currently has enough cash and bank balance on hand to cover this quarter's still-pending loan demand.
tips.Loan Amount Demanded This Quarter: How much loan money this CLF's member SHGs/VOs newly requested this specific quarter.
tips.This Quarter's Pending Loans: Of this quarter's new loan demand, how much hasn't been disbursed yet.
tips.Share of VOs Requesting Loans: The share of this CLF's member VOs/SHGs that actively requested a loan this quarter.
tips.Receipts Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly receipts have moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Payments Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly payments have moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Cash Balance Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly closing cash balance has moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Loans Disbursed Over Time: How this CLF's total loans disbursed has grown over the last five quarters.
tips.Disbursement Rate Over Time: How this CLF's disbursement rate has moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Balance Sheet: This CLF's full balance sheet, exactly as reported.
tips.Receipts & Payments Statement: This CLF's full receipts and payments statement for the selected quarter, exactly as reported.
tips.FSF-Eligible VOs: How many of this CLF's VOs qualify for the Food Security Fund — at least 40% of their members belong to SC/ST groups.
tips.VOs With Incomplete Coverage: How many VOs haven't yet received their full ₹1,50,000 VRF government grant.
tips.Idle VOs: Of the VOs that have received VRF funds, how many earned no interest from lending last year.
tips.Total VRF Received: The total VRF government grant this CLF's VOs have received to date.
tips.Total Savings Collected: The total member savings collected across this CLF's VOs.
tips.Total Interest Collected: The total interest earned by this CLF's VOs from lending VRF funds to members.
tips.Total Fund Size: The combined size of this CLF's VRF fund — grant, savings, and interest together.
tips.Coverage Gap: The total grant amount still owed to VOs that haven't received their full ₹1,50,000.
tips.Savings as Promised: How much of the savings members were supposed to contribute has actually been collected.
tips.What the Fund Is Made Of: How this CLF's VRF fund breaks down between the original government grant, member savings, and interest earned.
tips.Grant Not Fully Received: How many VOs are still owed part of their VRF grant.
tips.Fund Sitting Idle: How many VOs that have received VRF funds earned no interest from lending them out last year.
tips.VO Identity: Which VO this row is about, and who its bookkeeper is.
tips.VO Fund Status: Whether this VO is FSF-eligible, has received its full grant, and is currently lending out its VRF funds.
tips.SHG Members: How many SHG members belong to this VO.
tips.VO Fund Metrics: How well this VO is doing on savings discipline, interest earned, and overall fund growth.
tips.VO Savings Discipline %: How much of the promised monthly savings has actually been collected, out of what should have been saved by now.
tips.VO Interest Yield: How much of the total fund came from interest earned by lending to members, rather than from savings or the grant.
tips.VO Corpus Multiplier: How many times bigger the total fund has grown compared to the government grant it started with.
tips.Bookkeeper Identity: Which bookkeeper this row is about, how many VOs and members they cover, and their overall rank within this CLF.
tips.Bookkeeper Fund Metrics: How this bookkeeper's VOs are doing on savings, fund growth, and coverage, combined into one composite score.
tips.Fund Projections: Where this CLF's savings, interest, and total fund size are headed by 31 March 2027, under three different assumptions about lending activity.
tips.Social Development Fund: How much this CLF should be collecting from its VOs each month, and each year, for the Social Development Fund.
tips.Month-by-Month Projection: A month-by-month look at how this CLF's savings, interest, and total fund are projected to grow.
tips.Total Entitlement Demands: How many entitlement/scheme demands this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.Number of People Requesting: How many of this CLF's members raised an entitlement demand in the selected year - every person in this dataset has requested an NREGA job card, forming the base population.
tips.% of Job Cards Accessed: Of the members who requested an NREGA job card, what share have actually received it.
tips.Non-NREGA Schemes Requested: How many distinct government schemes, other than the NREGA job card itself, this CLF's members requested in the selected year - a count of scheme types touched, not total requests.
tips.Demand & Access by Scheme: Which government schemes this CLF's members are demanding most in the selected year. There's no fulfilment tracking for individual schemes in this data - only the NREGA job card's own accessed status is available, shown separately above.
tips.Total PGSRD Requests: How many public-goods, resource, or service requests this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.Type of Request: Whether requests are for public goods, resources, or services.
tips.Most-Requested Items: The specific items requested most often, and the total quantity demanded for each.
tips.By Development Theme: Which broader development themes these requests fall under.
tips.By GPDP Focus Area: Which Gram Panchayat Development Plan focus areas these requests relate to.
tips.Total Social Issues Raised: How many social development issues this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.By Sector: Which broad sector these issues fall under.
tips.Most-Raised Issues: The specific social issues raised most often, how many times each was raised, and roughly how many people each one affects.
tips.Government Departments Involved: Which government departments are most often implicated by these issues.
tips.Fund Deployment: This CLF's fund deployment ratio, converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Bookkeeping Accuracy: How closely this CLF's Assets match its Liabilities+Equity, converted to a percentile — a closer match ranks higher.
tips.VRF Fund Health: This CLF's VRF fund-management metrics, each converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Savings Discipline: How much of the savings this CLF's VOs were expected to have collected by now has actually come in, member-weighted across VOs and converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Savings Realisation: How much savings this CLF's VOs have collected relative to the size of the VRF government grant they've received, member-weighted across VOs and converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Corpus Multiplier: How many times bigger this CLF's VRF fund has grown compared to the government grant it started with, member-weighted across VOs and converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Interest Yield: How much of this CLF's VRF fund is made up of interest earned by lending to members, rather than the original grant or savings, member-weighted across VOs and converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Coverage Completion: The share of this CLF's VOs, member-weighted, that have received their full ₹1,50,000 VRF government grant, converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Subcommittee Completeness: How many of this CLF's six subcommittees are actually staffed, converted to a percentile.
tips.Active Membership: The share of this CLF's members currently marked active, converted to a percentile.
tips.Cadre Diversity: How many different specialised cadre roles this CLF has staffed, converted to a percentile.
tips.Insurance Coverage: The share of this CLF's members with insurance, converted to a percentile.
tips.Aadhaar KYC Coverage: The share of this CLF's members with Aadhaar KYC verified, converted to a percentile.
tips.Livelihoods Diversification: The share of this CLF's members with more than one livelihood activity, converted to a percentile.
tips.Overall Score: This CLF's overall performance score, combining fund management, financial health, governance, and inclusion into one number, and how it compares to other CLFs in its district and across Bihar.
tips.Arrears Rate: The share of this CLF's total current loan demand that is currently overdue (in arrears), per LokOS's live snapshot - lower is better, converted to a percentile against other CLFs with loan data.
tips.Funding Source Diversity: How many distinct fund headings (Community Investment Fund, Community Enterprise Fund, PMFME Seed Capital, and other central/state schemes) this CLF has actually received disbursements under, converted to a percentile against other CLFs with Fund Disbursement data.

context.overview: A snapshot of the CLF's identity, structure, and membership. Profile covers formation and registration details, CLF status (Model/Registered), platform approval status, governance structure (President, Secretary, Executive Committee, subcommittees), and meeting/savings schedule. Members covers social inclusion and welfare coverage (SC/ST, OBC, disability, etc.), education levels, livelihood diversification, special project activities, and the CLF's cadre roster.
context.audit: The CLF's most recent audit results (FY 2025-26, Q4): its overall grade and score, how it compares to other CLFs in its district and statewide, a breakdown across the 6 scoring categories, the individual line items behind each category, whether the auditor flagged a financial irregularity (and what kind), and a cash book vs. physical cash reconciliation check.
context.financial: The CLF's balance sheet, quarterly cash flow, and credit disbursement, for a selected quarter. Summary gives key ratios (liquidity, fund deployment, surplus/deficit, books balance check) and a breakdown of where capital and cash came from and went to. Statements shows the full balance sheet and receipts & payments statement, exactly as reported. Fund Disbursement shows the CLF's lifetime capital received from the state under every fund heading, not tied to a specific quarter.
context.loans: Tracks loans disbursed by the CLF to its member VOs, sourced from LokOS CLF-meeting records. Portfolio Overview gives CLF-wide totals, repayment/return metrics, portfolio composition, and every individual loan. Loan Schedule lets you inspect a from-scratch monthly amortization reconstruction for a specific VO/loan. Loans that have been fully repaid drop their origination details (amount, tenure, interest rate) from the source system once closed, so those loans show up with repayment history only.
context.vrf: Tracks the CLF's Vulnerability Reduction Fund, managed at the VO level. KPI Snapshot gives CLF-wide totals and fund health. VO-Level Breakdown lets you inspect every individual VO. Bookkeeper & CLF Rankings compares the CLF's fund management to peers and ranks its bookkeepers. Forecasts projects where the fund is headed by 31 March 2027 under three lending-activity scenarios.
context.vprp: Requests and plans raised through VPRP, by year (2023-2025). Entitlements tracks government scheme demands (ration cards, pensions, insurance, etc.) and NREGA job card status. PGSRD (Public Goods, Services, and Resource Development) tracks requests for public infrastructure, resources, and services. SDP (Social Development Plan) tracks broader social issues raised and the government departments involved.
context.scoring: Combines every other tab into one performance score, against the CLF's district and Bihar statewide. Overall gives one pooled score plus a category breakdown, and lets you customize the weight given to each category. By Category shows every individual metric behind all 7 categories, with district/state percentiles and ranks.

district_context.overview: A snapshot of the district's CLFs, aggregated across all of them. Profile covers CLF status distribution and district-wide governance structure (Executive Committee totals, subcommittee membership, summed across CLFs). Members covers social inclusion and welfare coverage, education levels, livelihood diversification, special project activities, and the district's cadre roster - all summed or member-weighted-averaged across every CLF in the district.
district_context.audit: The district's most recent audit results (FY 2025-26, Q4), averaged across every CLF with an audit on file: average grade and score, how this district compares statewide, a breakdown across the 6 scoring categories, the individual line items behind each category, how many CLFs were flagged for a financial irregularity (and what kind), and a cash book vs. physical cash reconciliation check.
district_context.financial: The district's balance sheet, quarterly cash flow, and credit disbursement, summed across every CLF for a selected quarter, with every ratio recomputed from those summed totals (not averaged CLF-by-CLF). Summary gives key ratios (liquidity, fund deployment, surplus/deficit, books balance check) and a breakdown of where capital and cash came from and went to. Statements shows the full balance sheet and receipts & payments statement, summed line-by-line across every CLF. Fund Disbursement shows lifetime capital received from the state under every fund heading, summed across every CLF in the district.
district_context.loans: Tracks loans disbursed to member VOs, summed across every CLF in the district with loan data. Portfolio Overview gives district-wide totals, repayment/return metrics recomputed from those totals (not averaged CLF-by-CLF), and portfolio composition. The per-loan Loan Schedule and full loan listing don't generalize to district scope and stay CLF-only.
district_context.vrf: Tracks the district's Vulnerability Reduction Fund, rolled up from every VO across every CLF in the district. KPI Snapshot gives district-wide totals and fund health. Forecasts projects where the fund is headed by 31 March 2027 under three lending-activity scenarios, summed across every CLF's own forecast.
district_context.vprp: Requests and plans raised through VPRP, by year (2023-2025), summed across every CLF in the district. Entitlements tracks government scheme demands (ration cards, pensions, insurance, etc.) and NREGA job card access. PGSRD (Public Goods, Services, and Resource Development) tracks requests for public infrastructure, resources, and services. SDP (Social Development Plan) tracks broader social issues raised and the government departments involved.
district_context.scoring: Combines every other tab into one performance score for the district, against Bihar statewide. Overall gives the district's average Overall Score (equal weight per CLF) plus a category breakdown. By Category shows every individual metric behind all 7 categories, averaged across the district's own CLFs. CLF Rankings lists every CLF in the district side by side, ranked by Overall Score.

state_context.overview: A snapshot of every CLF in Bihar, aggregated statewide. Profile covers CLF status distribution and statewide governance structure (Executive Committee totals, subcommittee membership, summed across every CLF). Members covers social inclusion and welfare coverage, education levels, livelihood diversification, special project activities, and the statewide cadre roster.
state_context.audit: The most recent audit results statewide (FY 2025-26, Q4), averaged across every CLF with an audit on file: average grade and score, a breakdown across the 6 scoring categories, the individual line items behind each category, how many CLFs were flagged for a financial irregularity (and what kind), and a cash book vs. physical cash reconciliation check.
state_context.financial: The balance sheet, quarterly cash flow, and credit disbursement of every CLF in Bihar, summed for a selected quarter, with every ratio recomputed from those summed totals (not averaged CLF-by-CLF). Summary gives key ratios and a breakdown of where capital and cash came from and went to. Statements shows the full balance sheet and receipts & payments statement, summed line-by-line across every CLF statewide. Fund Disbursement shows lifetime capital received from the state under every fund heading, summed across every CLF in Bihar.
state_context.loans: Tracks loans disbursed to member VOs, summed across every CLF statewide with loan data. Portfolio Overview gives statewide totals, repayment/return metrics recomputed from those totals (not averaged CLF-by-CLF), and portfolio composition. The per-loan Loan Schedule and full loan listing don't generalize to statewide scope and stay CLF-only.
state_context.vrf: Tracks Bihar's Vulnerability Reduction Fund, rolled up from every VO across every CLF in the state. KPI Snapshot gives statewide totals and fund health. Forecasts projects where the fund is headed by 31 March 2027 under three lending-activity scenarios, summed across every CLF's own forecast.
state_context.vprp: Requests and plans raised through VPRP, by year (2023-2025), summed across every CLF in Bihar. Entitlements tracks government scheme demands and NREGA job card access. PGSRD tracks requests for public infrastructure, resources, and services. SDP tracks broader social issues raised and the government departments involved.
state_context.scoring: Combines every other tab into one statewide performance score. Overall gives the average Overall Score across every CLF in Bihar (equal weight per CLF) plus a category breakdown. By Category shows every individual metric behind all 7 categories, averaged statewide. CLF Rankings shows the top 20 and bottom 20 CLFs in Bihar by Overall Score.

district_tips.Overall Score: This district's overall performance score, combining fund management, financial health, governance, and inclusion into one number, and how it compares to other districts across Bihar.

state_tips.Assets Composition: How Bihar's summed total assets break down across every balance-sheet line item - cash, bank balance, loans out to SHGs/VOs, fixed assets, and the rest.
state_tips.Liabilities Composition: How Bihar's summed total liabilities and equity break down across every balance-sheet line item - government grants, member capital, institutional loans, savings held on behalf of VOs/SHGs, and the rest.
state_tips.Where Money Came In From: What this quarter's receipts were made up of, summed across every CLF in Bihar - savings deposits, interest earned, loan repayments, and other income.
state_tips.Where Money Went Out To: What this quarter's payments were made up of, summed across every CLF in Bihar - loans and advances to member CBOs, running costs, and other expenses.
state_tips.Balance Sheet: Bihar's full balance sheet, summed line-by-line across every CLF with one on file.
state_tips.Receipts & Payments Statement: Bihar's full receipts and payments statement for the selected quarter, summed line-by-line across every CLF.
state_tips.Savings as Promised: How much of the savings VOs were supposed to contribute has actually been collected, across Bihar.
state_tips.What the Fund Is Made Of: How Bihar's VRF fund breaks down between the original government grant, member savings, and interest earned, summed across every CLF.
state_tips.Grant Not Fully Received: How many VOs in Bihar are still owed part of their VRF grant.
state_tips.Fund Sitting Idle: How many VOs in Bihar that have received VRF funds earned no interest from lending them out last year.
state_tips.Fund Projections: Where Bihar's savings, interest, and total fund size are headed by 31 March 2027, summed across every CLF's own forecast.
state_tips.Social Development Fund: How much CLFs across Bihar should be collecting from their VOs each month, and each year, for the Social Development Fund, combined.
state_tips.Month-by-Month Projection: A month-by-month look at how Bihar's savings, interest, and total fund are projected to grow.
state_tips.Demand & Access by Scheme: Which government schemes Bihar's members are demanding most in the selected year. There's no fulfilment tracking for individual schemes in this data - only the NREGA job card's own accessed status is available, shown separately above.
state_tips.Subcommittee Membership: How many members sit on each of the six functional subcommittees, summed across every CLF in Bihar.
state_tips.Fund Deployment: Bihar's actual average fund deployment ratio (not a percentile - see the note above), plus which district is doing best and worst on it.
state_tips.Bookkeeping Accuracy: How closely Bihar's summed Assets match its summed Liabilities+Equity, shown as the actual accuracy figure, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.VRF Fund Health: Bihar's VRF fund-management metrics, shown as actual values, plus which district is doing best and worst on each.
state_tips.Subcommittee Completeness: How many subcommittees are staffed on average across Bihar's CLFs, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Active Membership: The share of members currently marked active across Bihar, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Cadre Diversity: How many different specialised cadre roles are staffed on average across Bihar's CLFs, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Insurance Coverage: The share of members with insurance across Bihar, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Aadhaar KYC Coverage: The share of members with Aadhaar KYC verified across Bihar, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Livelihoods Diversification: The share of members with more than one livelihood activity across Bihar, plus which district is doing best and worst.
state_tips.Overall Score: Bihar's overall performance score, combining fund management, financial health, governance, and inclusion into one number, averaged equally across every CLF in the state.
